8: def project(x,mu):return x-mu*q_torch(x)[...,None]

13: class BoxChargeProjection(torch.autograd.Function):
14:     @staticmethod
15:     def forward(ctx,v,q):
16:         if v.dtype!=torch.float64 or q.dtype!=torch.float64:raise TypeError('constraint construction requires float64')
17:         if not torch.isfinite(v).all() or not torch.isfinite(q).all():raise FloatingPointError('nonfinite projection input')
18:         if (q.abs()>300).any():raise ValueError('absolute ADC charge constraint infeasible; no event deletion')
19:         a=charge_vector(v);answer=v.clone()
20:         change=((v<-.5)|(v>.5)).any(1)|(torch.abs(q_torch(v)-q)>1e-12)
21:         if change.any():
22:             u=v[change];qq=q[change];aa=a[:400]
23:             lower=torch.where(aa>0,(u[:,:400]-.5)/aa,(u[:,:400]+.5)/aa).amin(1)
24:             upper=torch.where(aa>0,(u[:,:400]+.5)/aa,(u[:,:400]-.5)/aa).amax(1)
25:             for _ in range(64):
26:                 mid=.5*(lower+upper);s=q_torch(torch.clamp(u-mid[:,None]*a,-.5,.5))
27:                 lower=torch.where(s>qq,mid,lower);upper=torch.where(s>qq,upper,mid)
28:             answer[change]=torch.clamp(u-.5*(lower+upper)[:,None]*a,-.5,.5)
29:         free=(answer>-.5)&(answer<.5);ctx.save_for_backward(free,a)
30:         return answer
31:     @staticmethod
32:     def backward(ctx,gradient):
33:         free,a=ctx.saved_tensors;active=free.to(gradient);den=(active*a.square()).sum(1)
34:         coefficient=(gradient*active*a).sum(1)/den.clamp_min(1.)
35:         gv=active*(gradient-coefficient[:,None]*a)
36:         gq=torch.where(den>0,coefficient,torch.zeros_like(coefficient))
37:         return gv,gq

39: def bounded_charge(v,q):return BoxChargeProjection.apply(v,q)

42:     # Match the existing float32 adc() output, then R51's common float64 codes.
43:     f=v.to(torch.float32);legacy=(-.5+torch.round((f.clamp(-.5,.5)+.5)*16383)/16383).to(torch.float32)
44:     canonical=-.5+torch.round((legacy.to(torch.float64)+.5)*16383).clamp(0,16383)/16383
45:     return v+(canonical-v).detach() if straight_through else canonical

50:     if steps not in [128,256]:raise ValueError('only the preregistered candidate/reference steps are permitted')
51:     y=initial.clone();h=1./steps
52:     for _ in range(steps):
53:         k1=displacement;k2=displacement
54:         y=y+(h*.5)*(k1+k2)
55:     return y

57: def displacement(network,source,noise,q,b,condition,mu,scale):
58:     guide=(source/q[:,None]-mu[b])/scale[b]
59:     initial=source+noise;noisy=(initial/q[:,None]-mu[b])/scale[b]
60:     f=network(noisy,b,guide,condition).to(torch.float64)
61:     delta=q[:,None]*project(scale[b]*f,mu[b])
62:     return initial,delta

65:     initial,delta=displacement(network,source,noise,q,b,condition,mu,scale)
66:     raw=initial+delta;out=bounded_charge(raw,q)
67:     return out,raw

5: class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
6:     def __init__(self,cin,cout):
7:         super().__init__();self.n1=nn.GroupNorm(8,cin);self.c1=nn.Conv1d(cin,cout,3,padding=1)
8:         self.n2=nn.GroupNorm(8,cout);self.film=nn.Linear(128,2*cout);self.c2=nn.Conv1d(cout,cout,3,padding=1)
9:         self.skip=nn.Identity() if cin==cout else nn.Conv1d(cin,cout,1)
10:     def forward(self,x,e):
11:         z=self.c1(torch.nn.functional.silu(self.n1(x)));scale,shift=self.film(e).chunk(2,1)
12:         z=self.n2(z)*(1+scale[:,:,None])+shift[:,:,None]
13:         return self.skip(x)+self.c2(torch.nn.functional.silu(z))
14: 
15: class Attention(nn.Module):
16:     def __init__(self):
17:         super().__init__();self.norm=nn.LayerNorm(128);self.attn=nn.MultiheadAttention(128,4,dropout=0.,batch_first=True)
18:     def forward(self,x):
19:         z=x.transpose(1,2);n=self.norm(z)
20:         return (z+self.attn(n,n,n,need_weights=False)[0]).transpose(1,2)
21: 
22: class ResponseNetwork(nn.Module):
23:     def __init__(self):
24:         super().__init__();self.embedding=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(9,128),nn.SiLU(),nn.Linear(128,128),nn.SiLU())
25:         self.register_buffer('position',torch.linspace(-1.,1.,480).reshape(1,1,480))
26:         self.input=nn.Conv1d(3,32,3,padding=1)
27:         self.enc=nn.ModuleList([nn.ModuleList([ResidualBlock(c,c),ResidualBlock(c,c)]) for c in [32,64,128,128]])
28:         self.down=nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv1d(a,b,3,stride=2,padding=1) for a,b in [(32,64),(64,128),(128,128)]])
29:         self.attention=Attention()
30:         self.up=nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv1d(a,b,3,padding=1) for a,b in [(128,128),(128,64),(64,32)]])
31:         self.dec=nn.ModuleList([nn.ModuleList([ResidualBlock(2*c,c),ResidualBlock(c,c)]) for c in [128,64,32]])
32:         self.final_norm=nn.GroupNorm(8,32);self.final=nn.Conv1d(32,1,3,padding=1)
33:         nn.init.zeros_(self.final.weight);nn.init.zeros_(self.final.bias)
34:     def forward(self,noisy,b,guide,charge_condition):
35:         y=noisy.to(self.final.weight);g=guide.to(y);h=charge_condition.to(y).reshape(-1,1)
36:         onehot=torch.nn.functional.one_hot(b.to(torch.int64),8).to(y)
37:         e=self.embedding(torch.cat((h,onehot),1))
38:         z=self.input(torch.cat((y[:,None],g[:,None],self.position.to(y).expand(len(y),-1,-1)),1));skips=[]
39:         for j,blocks in enumerate(self.enc):
40:             z=blocks[0](z,e)
41:             if j==3:z=self.attention(z)
42:             z=blocks[1](z,e);skips.append(z)
43:             if j<3:z=self.down[j](z)
44:         for j,(up,blocks) in enumerate(zip(self.up,self.dec)):
45:             z=up(torch.nn.functional.interpolate(z,scale_factor=2,mode='nearest'))
46:             z=blocks[1](blocks[0](torch.cat((z,skips[2-j]),1),e),e)
47:         return self.final(torch.nn.functional.silu(self.final_norm(z)))[:,0]
